[{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Thank you for your interest in Sacramento State!


This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in the major: Sacramento State courses on the left and approved (articulated) transfer courses on the right. Although completion of the coursework listed below is not mandatory prior to admission, students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer.


Additional Resources:

  • See the University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major.
  • Visit our Sac State Apply page for more information about our campus!
  • Visit the Admissions website for current transfer admission requirements.
  • Connect with an Admissions Counselor.

  1. It is very important for students who intend to major in Physics, or obtain a single subject Teaching Credential in Science/Physics Emphasis, to complete most of the core preparatory courses listed below during their first two college years. By completing the 4 semesters of Mathematics, 3 semesters of Physics, and 2 semesters of Chemistry, students will be prepared to take upper-division Physics courses necessary for the major after transfer.
  2. Foreign Language Graduation Requirement Exemption: Students graduating with a Bachelor of Science Degree in Physics will not be subject to the University’s Foreign Language Graduation Requirement. Students who change major may be subject to the University’s Foreign Language Graduation Requirement.
  3. Students with an interest in theoretical physics are encouraged to consider a minor in Mathematics.
  4. For additional information, please visit: Department of Physics.
